contract.jsonValidation: JSON is parsed before file or resource mutation; invalid JSON does not alter file bytes or project revision.
contract.projectPathSafety: Relative project-local paths only; absolute/path traversal/symlink traversal are rejected.
contract.operationAtomicity: File replacement and resource registration/update are rolled back together if the individual write operation fails.
contract.safetyTransactionLimitation: A later safety.transactions rollback restores project data but does not restore physical file bytes already written by a successful text resource operation.

packaging.collisionPolicy: basename with numeric suffix starting at 2

removalCoverage.coverage: Existing AssetTools regressions cover safe project-local physical deletion plus used/shared/outside-project rejection.

notes: The live acceptance creates the Spanish locale exclusively through MCP after project.save-as; it does not pre-create or register the locale with filesystem orchestration.
An orphaned registered JSON resource is still copied by the native preview/export pipeline, matching gd::ResourceExposer and ResourcesMergingHelper behavior.
The actual preview URL is discovered from desktop.windows.list, and the packaged resource is resolved relative to that URL rather than by guessing the preview directory.
